in_hebrew.name: Haag
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Hedge or enclosure
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Haag הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old High German word 'hag', meaning 'hedge' or 'enclosure'. This name may have been given to children born in rural areas, or those whose families farmed or worked in agriculture.

in_greek.name: Haag
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Hedge or enclosure
in_greek.long_meaning: Haag είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old High German word 'hag', meaning 'hedge' or 'enclosure'. This name may have been given to children born in rural areas, or those whose families farmed or worked in agriculture.

in_latin.name: Haag
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Hedge or enclosure
in_latin.long_meaning: Haag est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old High German word 'hag', meaning 'hedge' or 'enclosure'. This name may have been given to children born in rural areas, or those whose families farmed or worked in agriculture.
